notes.title: Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and thank you for all of your continued support <3 

As of now Two Steps Back has badges, emotes, background, and trading cards for your collection pleasure~ 

I hope you enjoy the work! 

I've also entered the Indie Game Maker contest! You can test out and vote for my second game here: 

http://contest.gamedevfort.com/submission/346#.Vc1m9flVikr

Thank you all so much once again for your support <3
